entries.note: Running goes through the retained host's terminal route with a payload built here (bash + resolved script + literal args + env for scripts, the argv itself for logs) so the replaceable worker never spawns PTYs; unavailable actions are refused with the missing items and capture actions are redirected. Captures reuse the format runner (no shell, cwd = root, 10 s / 8 MiB), require the PNG signature before touching disk, create `into` after a lexical boundary check and confine its realpath, then write the image and the manifest through temp-and-rename; a same-millisecond collision gets a numeric suffix. The returned title also overrides the snapshot because a retained host older than the title option labels sessions generically. The action is now selected once by dashboardAction and passed in, because a game action does not produce a terminal payload at all: the caller launches it through the project game route and returns that game session, so this function refuses the game kind the way it already refuses capture.
